palette: Shared sound palette for the whole game: glockenspiel, celesta, marimba, sleigh bells, soft felt piano, warm toy brass, plucky bass, wooden toy percussion, and puffy snow foley. Cozy, warm, toy-like winter; never harsh, metallic, realistic or scary.
style: One consistent set: every sound must feel like it comes from the same world. Use the shared palette. Tonal sounds in D major (the North, boss and finale music in D minor). Effects are short and dry (no big reverb, a small room at most), start instantly with no silence at the front, and contain no music or voices unless the item asks for them.
voice: One voice for all six lines: a cheerful, bright, friendly cartoon announcer, excited but never shouty, cleared for commercial use (never a copy of a real person). Each line under 1 second, no music or effects behind it.
rights: Use a Fish Audio paid plan: paid plans include commercial rights; the free tier's terms aren't stated.
order: 1) the 8 priority-A effects, then send those to the account owner for Alex to hear in the game before going on; 2) music_job; 3) the other 4 tracks, written with the same palette and given music_job as the reference track wherever the tool takes one; 4) the 6 voice lines; 5) the B and C effects.

deliver.format: WAV, 44.1 kHz, 16-bit. WAV is lossless, and MP3 adds silence at the start and end that breaks seamless loops. The game's final MP3s are made from these.
deliver.takes: Deliver every take, numbered: <name>_1.wav, <name>_2.wav, <name>_3.wav. Don't pick a favourite; we choose by listening in the game.
deliver.manifest: manifest.csv in the zip root, one row per file: file,type,take,seconds_actual,prompt_used,notes
deliver.problems: If the tool can't make an item exactly as written, stop and tell the account owner. Don't swap in something else.

items.name: sweep
items.when: CLEAN SWEEP! at 98%: the last snow melts away in a ring and the job ends.
items.prompt: Magical cozy winter sweep: a soft rising whoosh of powdery snow swirling outward, ending in a bright sparkling glockenspiel arpeggio in D major, cheerful toy-like video game reward, dry, no reverb tail

items.name: treasure
items.when: Finding a treasure in the snow.
items.prompt: Treasure discovered: a warm music box and glockenspiel flourish rising in D major with a sparkle at the end, cozy winter, toy-like, short and joyful, no reverb tail

items.name: pow
items.when: The punch under a crash (plays on top of the bump sound).
items.prompt: Short cartoon impact thump, soft and puffy like crashing into a big snowbank, with a quick muffled pop, toy-like and playful, not violent, very short, no reverb

items.name: swipe
items.when: Jobs, Upgrades and Garage pages sliding across.
items.prompt: Very short soft swipe whoosh, like a card sliding quickly across a table, airy and light, subtle UI sound, no click

items.name: bookopen
items.when: Opening the Treasure Book.
items.prompt: Old leather-bound book opening: a soft leather creak and a gentle paper flutter, cozy, close-up, short, dry

items.name: crack
items.when: First bump halves your combo and the bar blinks CAREFUL!
items.prompt: Small cartoon ice crack: a quick crisp crackle of thin ice with a tiny falling two-note blip, light and playful, a warning not a failure, very short, dry

items.name: testdrive
items.when: Grabbing a test-drive key: you jump into a Wild Ride for 15 s.
items.prompt: Exciting transformation: a quick rising whoosh into a big cartoon engine rev with a bright sparkle at the top, energetic but cozy and toy-like, video game power-up, no voice, dry

items.name: newmachine
items.when: Buying a new machine in the Garage.
items.prompt: Big cozy unveiling: a chunky toy engine starting up and revving twice, then a bright glockenspiel and brass flourish in D major, triumphant but warm and toy-like, video game unlock, no voice, dry

items.name: dizzy
items.when: After a crash, while stars circle your head.
items.prompt: Cartoon dizzy stars: three or four soft twinkling bell chirps circling around, slightly wobbly pitch, light and funny, kids game, quiet

items.name: confetti
items.when: Opening a gift: confetti and coins burst out.
items.prompt: Small party popper pop followed by light paper confetti fluttering, cheerful and soft, short, kids game, no voice

items.name: glint
items.when: At 90%, sparkles appear on the last snow patches.
items.prompt: Single soft magical glint, a tiny high bell sparkle with a shimmer, gentle, short, in D major, video game hint sound

items.name: lookcloser
items.when: Tapping a treasure to open its close-up card.
items.prompt: Soft magical reveal shimmer, a quick rising sparkle with a light bell, gentle, short, in D major, UI sound

items.name: page
items.when: Flipping to the next or previous treasure.
items.prompt: Single paper page turn, crisp but soft, close microphone, short, dry

items.name: maxed
items.when: Tapping a maxed-out upgrade (MAXED OUT!).
items.prompt: Satisfying golden ding, a bright bell strike with a short shimmer, like a completed achievement, in D major, short and clean

items.name: part
items.when: Picking up a Wild Ride part in a job.
items.prompt: Treasure pickup with a mechanical twist: a chunky toy metal clank, then a quick bright sparkle and a rising two-note chime in D major, cozy, short, dry

items.name: mk2
items.when: Buying a machine's Mk II upgrade.
items.prompt: Golden power-up: a deep engine rev rising into a shimmering gold chime chord in D major, triumphant but short, toy-like, dry

items.name: collect

items.prompt: A cascade of coins pouring onto a pile, bright and satisfying, ending in a soft bell ding in D major, cozy video game reward, dry

items.name: shiphorn

items.prompt: Deep friendly ship horn, two short warm toots like a cartoon tugboat, round and soft, not scary, clean and dry

items.name: bookclose
items.when: Closing the Treasure Book.
items.prompt: Book closing softly: a muffled leather thump with a light paper swish, short, dry

items.name: streak
items.when: Claiming the daily streak reward.
items.prompt: Daily reward: a quick rising run of five glockenspiel notes in D major ending on a soft chord, joyful, cozy winter, toy-like, dry

items.name: scoop

items.name: icecrunch
items.when: Loops while the Icebreaker drives over cleared ice.
items.prompt: Steady crunching of thin ice under heavy tracks, crisp crackles over a soft low rumble, even and continuous with no big hits, cozy not harsh, seamless loop

items.name: music_job
items.when: During every job (32 bars at 104 BPM).
items.prompt: Upbeat playful winter game music, 104 BPM, D major, plucky bass, sleigh-bell shaker, bright glockenspiel and marimba melody, warm and fun, energetic but never stressful, no vocals, seamless loop

items.name: music_menu
items.when: Map, Upgrades, Garage, shop (32 bars at 82 BPM).
items.prompt: Cozy lo-fi winter music, 82 BPM, D major, soft electric piano, gentle bells, light vinyl crackle, warm and calm, no vocals, seamless loop

items.name: music_north
items.when: Frozen North jobs and the Ice Palace (32 bars at 104 BPM).
items.prompt: Adventurous winter game music, 104 BPM, D minor, driving taiko-style drums, plucked strings, icy bells, a little epic but still playful, no vocals, seamless loop

items.name: music_boss
items.when: The 7 area boss jobs, while the chaser hunts you (32 bars at 112 BPM). One shared boss track; the Ice Palace has its own finale.
items.prompt: Tense but playful chase music for a cozy winter game, 112 BPM, D minor, bouncy staccato strings, ticking woodblock, cheeky bassoon, quick sleigh bells, mischievous rather than scary, no vocals, seamless loop

items.name: music_finale
items.when: The Ice Palace, the final boss job (32 bars at 96 BPM).
items.prompt: Grand but cozy finale music for a winter game's last boss, 96 BPM, D minor lifting to D major in the second half, bold low strings and taiko drums, soaring glockenspiel and celesta melody, sleigh bells, toy brass, epic and triumphant rather than scary, no vocals, seamless loop
